environment: Ubuntu 22.04 under WSL2; Mesa Dozen Vulkan-to-D3D12 bridge through /dev/dxg; not bare-metal Linux

mesa.selection: Both VK_DRIVER_FILES and VK_ICD_FILENAMES name the one isolated ICD; LD_LIBRARY_PATH selects its private library directory and /usr/lib/wsl/lib. No global installation.

unchanged_acceptance: Inherit every image, voxel, radius, transfer and retained-pool gate from the parent plan and runner. Both preferences must complete every fixed frame, and their accepted reports must establish both required hardware classes. Cpu/VirtualGpu/Other, missing reports, failed processes, failed frames and duplicate hardware classes cannot satisfy hardware coverage.
provenance: Before execution, freeze source-tree identities, binary/input/runtime library/ICD hashes and the protocol commit. Preserve each process status, complete stdout/stderr and all failed cases. Report no local adapter model names.

storage.scope: Controlled source/build/temp/cache/results use E; operating-system and proprietary driver allocations/caches are outside these counters. Preserve all older data, binaries and receipts.

scope: Selected development-frame correctness and explicit transfer conformance through one WSL2 bridge configuration. No performance ranking, physical sensor calibration, trajectory accuracy, bare-metal portability, broad Vulkan conformance or completed operational 80% claim.
